newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libya condemns U.S. attack on Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Libya condemns U.S. attack on Iraq.

text.p: Libya on Tuesday condemned the United States attack on Iraq as infringing the Arab state's sovereignty, the official Libyan news agency JANA reported.

"The American aggression against Iraq constitutes an infringement to an Arab country's sovereignty and an interference in its internal affairs," JANA quoted Libyan (Pan-Arab) Unity Affairs Jomaa al-Fezzani as saying.
"It is Iraq's right to exert its sovereignty over all its lands within its territorial integrity," Fezzani added in a statement after a meeting with Iraqi ambassador to Tripoli.
"What Iraq face and what the Arab Nation is facing from threats requires an Arab commitment...to the Arab defence pact," Fezzani said.
